purpose: Freeze the Banner Stage 2 production manifest and its eight production artifacts as the only canonical inputs that Banner Stage 3 consumers may use, and verify cross-artifact identity/relation/history continuity without reopening Stage 2 semantics.

semanticFreeze.definitionIdentity: bannerDefinitionId is the frozen Stage 2 deterministic canonical ID
semanticFreeze.sourceNullManualGrouping: one occurrence-scoped definition unless an explicit approved mapping is introduced
semanticFreeze.heroRelations: only canonical Hero ID edges emitted by Stage 2-5 are accepted
semanticFreeze.cpRelation: CP_RELATED remains a non-exclusive context relation
semanticFreeze.eventRelation: event references remain text-only while canonicalEventId is unresolved
semanticFreeze.assetRole: Stage 2 occurrence display data is provenance/display metadata, not canonical banner identity

sourcePriority: the eight Stage 2 production artifacts referenced by that manifest
targeted Stage 1/ConfigData lookup only when Stage 3 requires a genuinely new asset/frontend relation
doNotInfer: canonical Event IDs from event text labels
Hero IDs for source-null manual Wish definitions
first-ever release dates outside the current dataset
future recurrence dates from observed gaps
canonical banner identity from displayImageFile, asset equality, Hero set, bannerCode, or display name
consumerPolicy.stage3DisplayHandoff: Existing occurrence display.imageFile/imageStatus values may be consumed only as Stage 2 provenance for the Stage 3 asset census. Canonical asset ownership/hash/visual duplicate semantics remain deferred to Stage 3-1.
consumerPolicy.nextStage: Banner Stage 3-1 asset relation / asset census
